named_method: Symbolic geometry proof search using provided construction definitions and inference rules
definition: Translate each problem into facts/goals over the provided predicate language and attempt forward-chaining / heuristic proof search with explicit rule applications.
assumptions: Benchmark lines are parseable into constructions and a single query goal
Definitions provide derivable primitive predicates from constructions
Rules are used as machine-verifiable inference templates
invariants: Per-problem outputs retain the original problem identifier
Each verification claim is backed by an explicit trace or marked unresolved
Aggregate metrics are computed directly from per-problem outputs
non_negotiable_steps: Expand constructions via defs.txt where straightforward
Apply rules.txt as exact symbolic inference patterns
Check whether target goal appears in derived facts
Save proof traces and unresolved states
